title: Canaries that must fail, proving the scorer can detect failure
goal: Include intents whose correct outcome is a typed refusal - a command-shaped input that Mandate 55 requires susi to refuse - and intents that must fail, then assert the scorer reports them as failures. A ladder that cannot fail is a dashboard; this task is the difference between measuring the system and decorating it, and it is the cheapest guard against an acceptance that proves nothing.
